{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Refinery''' converts collected mining fragments into whole tonnes of cargo. It is required for ordinary mining profits because loose fragments are not saleable cargo until they have been processed.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Refinery}}

The refinery is shared by [[Laser Mining]], [[Core Mining]], [[Sub-surface Mining]], and [[Surface Deposit Mining]]. Collectors deliver fragments or chunks to the ship, and the refinery fills bins until a full tonne can be moved into cargo.

== Operating notes ==

* More bins make mixed-fragment mining easier because several partial commodities can be held at once.
* A full cargo hold can stop the refinery from completing new tonnes.
* Unwanted or low-priority fragments may need to be ignored or vented so useful commodities can continue processing.
* The refinery does not choose profitable cargo by itself; the commander still has to plan the run and check market demand.
